---
title: "GB7CAM Network Graph"
format:
  html:
    self-contained: true
execute:
  echo: false
---

<div id="controls" style="display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px;">
  <input id="filter" placeholder="Filter node e.g. GB7FCI" style="padding:6px;width:220px;">
  <label>
    <input type="checkbox" id="opMode">
    Operator mode
  </label>
</div>

<div id="network" style="height: 90vh; border: 1px solid #ddd; background: #ffffff;"></div>

<script src="https://unpkg.com/vis-network/standalone/umd/vis-network.min.js"></script>

<script>
const API = "https://api.gb7cam.org.uk/graph";

let nodesDS;
let edgesDS;
let fullData;
let network;

/* ----------------------------
   NODE COLOURS
---------------------------- */
function nodeColor(id) {

  // collapse ALL GB7CAM variants
  if (id.startsWith("GB7CAM")) return "#e74c3c"; // core red

  if (id.startsWith("GB7")) return "#3498db";     // UK infra
  if (id.startsWith("M7") || id.startsWith("2E1")) return "#2ecc71";
  if (id.startsWith("KC2") || id.startsWith("N2") || id.startsWith("ZL")) return "#f1c40f";

  return "#7f8c8d";
}

/* ----------------------------
   PORT COLOURS
---------------------------- */
function portColor(port) {
  switch(String(port)) {
    case "1": return "#2ecc71"; // RF
    case "2": return "#f39c12"; // Telnet
    case "3": return "#3498db"; // AXIP
    default:  return "#95a5a6";
  }
}

/* ----------------------------
   EDGE WIDTH
---------------------------- */
function width(q) {
  if (!q) return 1;
  return Math.max(1, Math.min(8, q / 45));
}

/* ----------------------------
   EDGE STYLE (FIXED SEMANTICS)
---------------------------- */
function edgeStyle(e) {

  const active = e.state === "Active";
  const unknown = e.quality === 0;

  return {
    width: width(e.quality),

    color: {
      color: portColor(e.port),
      highlight: "#2c3e50"
    },

    arrows: "to",

    font: {
      color: "#2c3e50",
      size: 10
    },

    // FIXED: dashed is NOT "dead", only unknown metric
    dashes: unknown,

    shadow: active
  };
}

/* ----------------------------
   LOAD DATA
---------------------------- */
async function load() {

  const res = await fetch(API);
  fullData = await res.json();

  const nodeMap = new Map();

  // nodes
  (fullData.nodes || []).forEach(n => {
    nodeMap.set(n.id, {
      id: n.id,
      label: `${n.id}\n${n.alias || ""}`,
      color: nodeColor(n.id)
    });
  });

  // ensure endpoints exist (IMPORTANT FIX)
  (fullData.edges || []).forEach(e => {

    if (!nodeMap.has(e.source)) {
      nodeMap.set(e.source, {
        id: e.source,
        label: e.source,
        color: nodeColor(e.source)
      });
    }

    if (!nodeMap.has(e.target)) {
      nodeMap.set(e.target, {
        id: e.target,
        label: e.target,
        color: nodeColor(e.target)
      });
    }
  });

  nodesDS = new vis.DataSet([...nodeMap.values()]);

  edgesDS = new vis.DataSet(
    (fullData.edges || []).map((e, i) => ({
      id: i,
      from: e.source,
      to: e.target,
      ...edgeStyle(e)
    }))
  );

  network = new vis.Network(
    document.getElementById("network"),
    { nodes: nodesDS, edges: edgesDS },
    {
      physics: {
        stabilization: true,
        barnesHut: {
          gravitationalConstant: -8000,
          springLength: 130
        }
      },

      nodes: {
        shape: "dot",
        size: 14,
        font: {
          color: "#2c3e50"
        },
        borderWidth: 1
      },

      edges: {
        smooth: {
          type: "dynamic"
        }
      }
    }
  );

  setupUI();
}

/* ----------------------------
   FILTER WITH NEIGHBOURS
---------------------------- */
function computeVisible(filterText, opMode) {

  const adj = new Map();

  (fullData.edges || []).forEach(e => {
    if (!adj.has(e.source)) adj.set(e.source, new Set());
    if (!adj.has(e.target)) adj.set(e.target, new Set());

    adj.get(e.source).add(e.target);
    adj.get(e.target).add(e.source);
  });

  let seed = new Set();

  if (filterText) {
    const f = filterText.toUpperCase();
    fullData.nodes.forEach(n => {
      if (n.id.includes(f) || (n.alias||"").toUpperCase().includes(f)) {
        seed.add(n.id);
      }
    });
  }

  if (opMode && seed.size === 0) {
    fullData.nodes.forEach(n => seed.add(n.id));
  }

  let visible = new Set(seed);

  seed.forEach(n => {
    (adj.get(n) || []).forEach(x => visible.add(x));
  });

  if (!filterText && !opMode) {
    fullData.nodes.forEach(n => visible.add(n.id));
  }

  return visible;
}

/* ----------------------------
   APPLY FILTER
---------------------------- */
function apply() {

  const filter = document.getElementById("filter").value;
  const op = document.getElementById("opMode").checked;

  const visible = computeVisible(filter, op);

  nodesDS.forEach(n => {
    nodesDS.update({
      id: n.id,
      hidden: !visible.has(n.id)
    });
  });

  edgesDS.forEach(e => {
    edgesDS.update({
      id: e.id,
      hidden: !(visible.has(e.from) && visible.has(e.to))
    });
  });
}

function setupUI() {
  document.getElementById("filter").addEventListener("input", apply);
  document.getElementById("opMode").addEventListener("change", apply);
}

load();
</script>
